title: DOW-UAP-PR077, "2 November 2020 [CALLSIGN] [CALLSIGN] Observes and tracks UAP 1 of 2"
what_is_it: Infrared video recording from a U.S. military platform showing the observation and tracking of an unidentified anomalous phenomenon (UAP).
interpretation_warnings: No extracted text available from the video itself — all facts derive from metadata and the CSV description provided by war.gov.
AARO uses qualifying language ('likely derived from'), indicating the provenance is assessed but not confirmed.
The materials lack a substantiated chain-of-custody, meaning the origin and handling of the video cannot be independently verified.
Two callsigns in the title are redacted, preventing identification of the observing platform or crew.
The video description is truncated at '03:15-03:17: A secon' — the full description of what occurs at that timestamp is incomplete.
This is video 1 of 2; the companion video (2 of 2) may contain additional context not available here.
The term 'UAP' in the title was applied by the uploader, not necessarily by AARO or official investigators.
